quantification_method: Unique-peptide log2 intensities; drop all-missing peptides. Per protein, alternating median peptide intercept/sample effect (25 steps, tol 1e-6), then 40 alternating IRLS weighted least-squares steps (tol 1e-7). Peptide weight 1/[1+(max(0,median absolute residual - 0.12)/0.32)^4], capped at 0.45 for <3 observations; per-observation Huber weight min(1,0.40/abs(residual)). Protein log2 profile = fitted sample effect + median fitted peptide intercept; use only observed cells, no sample normalization or imputation.
shared_peptide_handling: Excluded all multiply mapped peptides (semicolon-delimited Proteins) from quantification; retained in manifest count only.
